answer: Each challenge commits to a domain-separated hash of its task data and a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse, so valid work cannot be known before the pulse is published. A sybil swarm cannot precompute or farm responses offline: every identity must solve fresh, beacon-bound work, while commit-reveal conceals submissions until verification. Whether labeled jade, haven, or atlas, identities gain no advantage because the beacon is unpredictable and unbiasable.
